notice: Simple execution contract: how GTT hands the human something to run as one line and one command. Data only. The engine (.gtt/scripts/gtt_run.py) and the CLI (gtt run) read it; neither carries these texts or numbers of its own.
threshold: When the human must execute something: a governed act is one promotion command; anything that changes state or takes two or more commands is a run plan in gtt-domain/run/ (gtt-run.sh new, then generate), handed over as `gtt run <n>`; a single read-only command may be given inline. Never write the script yourself, never run it, and never ask the human to assemble a sequence.

lines.check: a tool that must exist before starting: `check: <command>`; the command must exit 0
lines.step: `step: <title> | <command>`; one command per step, announced and stopped on its first failure
lines.next: `next: <text>`; said when the last step ends

plan.governed_acts: A step may call a governed act (`gtt promote <set>`, `gtt freeze`); it keeps its own diff and confirmation.

rules.statement: a step does not write, redirect to, copy over, move or delete anything under gtt-domain/context/, gtt-domain/adr/, .gtt/ or a path in .gtt/protection/registry.yaml
a step does not run a Git command that writes history, unless gtt-domain/workflow.md declares `commits: allowed`
`rm -rf` only inside the project's temporary folders (tmp, temp, .tmp, .cache, build, dist, node_modules, target) or the system temporary directory
no `curl` or `wget` piped into a shell
the script is exactly what the generator makes from the plan (the seal); a hand-edited or missing script is refused
the plan states What it does, Why and Changes (none | environment | data | code) and has at least one step
whatever shellcheck reports, when it is installed

changes.environment: changes your environment; does not touch the code
cambia tu entorno; no toca el código
